title: feat: add verified Novita Economics collection guidance
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Novita’s direct billing account and API collection guidance to Economics, keeping gateway charges separate.
- Documents verified decimal charges, partial-period coverage, restricted vouchers, and recharge invoice handling.
- Adds Novita model discovery and usage validation guidance.
- Fixes local OAuth failures by sharing Vite and Wrangler’s migrated Enter state.
- Validation: 416 Economics, 190 Gen, and 17 Enter tests; Economics typecheck/build; live Novita billing/catalog/quota and streaming/non-streaming probes; authenticated local dashboard with the staging reader.

The proposed staging ledger import awaits separate approval; this PR contains no ledger writes or secret changes.

Addresses #16597. Direct routing landed in #16604.

gist.headline: Keeping the Novita books straight
gist.blurb: Novita gets a collection guide that keeps direct billing separate from gateway charges. The staging ledger remains untouched; even the spreadsheets get a review step.
gist.summary: Added verified Novita direct-billing collection guidance covering decimal charges, partial periods, restricted vouchers, recharge invoices, model discovery, and usage validation, while sharing migrated Enter state between Vite and Wrangler to fix local OAuth.
gist.impact: Economics maintainers can validate Novita charges and usage without mixing them with gateway charges, and developers can authenticate the local dashboard; this PR makes no ledger writes.
gist.visual_concept: Polli, wearing a tiny bookkeeper's visor, checks two clearly separate pixel ledgers labeled NOVITA and GATEWAY. A friendly CRT monitor robot holds a small model catalog beside a glowing lime-green code-plant; the scene represents verified collection guidance rather than an automated ledger import.
